templates.name: kanban
templates.description: Organize tasks into columns with drag-and-drop, priorities, and due dates
capabilities: Create and organize cards into columns
Filter and sort cards by any field
Track task progress across workflow stages
prompts: Add these tasks to my board: design homepage, write docs, set up CI
Move all high-priority cards to the In Progress column
Show me all cards due this week

templates.name: todo
templates.description: Simple task list with categories, priorities, and completion tracking
capabilities: Create and manage tasks with due dates
Mark tasks complete and track progress
prompts: Add a task: buy groceries, due tomorrow, high priority
Show me all incomplete tasks due this week
Mark the groceries task as done

templates.name: crm
templates.description: Track contacts, companies, and interactions for personal or small-team CRM
capabilities: Store contact details and company information
Search and filter contacts by any field
prompts: Add a contact: Jane Smith, CEO at Acme Corp, jane@acme.com
Log a call with Jane about the Q2 proposal
Show me all contacts at Acme Corp

templates.name: habit-tracker
templates.description: Build and maintain daily habits with streaks, reminders, and progress visualization
capabilities: Define habits with frequency and target goals
Track daily completions and build streaks
prompts: Create a habit: meditate for 10 minutes every morning
Show my current streaks for all habits
